policies.title: Madagascar: short-stay visa on arrival for foreign ordinary passports
policies.summary: Madagascar requires every non-Malagasy nationality to hold a visa but permits the short-stay visa process at international airports and ports, with online pre-application as an optional alternative.
conditions: Ordinary-passport tourism and other eligible non-immigrant short visits only. The reviewed Embassy guidance says every non-Malagasy nationality needs a visa and describes the short-stay visa as available at Madagascar's international airports and ports.

The Ministry of Tourism says a single-entry stay visa may be requested at the arrival airport or online. Because no advance authorisation is necessary when using the arrival route, this policy is normalized as visa on arrival rather than eVisa.

Decree No. 2017-1021 applies the eVisa system to every foreign non-immigrant and permits instructions online or at arrival. An online landing authorisation is not a travel document or a guarantee that the border visa will be granted.

Current consular requirements include a completed form, recent photographs, an ordinary passport valid more than six months after the return date with at least two blank pages, return travel, accommodation, and payment of the applicable visa fee.
Short-stay visas may be extended only within a cumulative 90-day maximum, are not convertible to long-stay status, and do not authorize paid or profit-making activity.
Yellow-fever certification may be required after recent presence in an infected country. Border officers retain admissibility authority.

Does not classify immigration, residence, employment, study exceeding short-stay scope, transit without border clearance, crew, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, refugee, stateless or other special-document cases.

application.label: Official eVisa Madagascar delegated-service portal
steps: Choose either the border application route or the optional online process linked by the Ministry of Tourism.
For online pre-application, submit the requested identity, passport, trip and accommodation information and retain the landing authorisation.
At the entry point, present the required original documents, landing authorisation if used, and payment receipt or complete the arrival application and fee payment with immigration officers.

policies.title: Madagascar: citizenship treatment
policies.summary: A Malagasy citizen using an ordinary Madagascar national passport is represented as citizenship rather than foreign visitor admission.
conditions: Represents an ordinary Madagascar national passport holder returning to Madagascar, not the diplomatic, service or foreign visitor categories.
Does not classify dual-nationality, foreign residence, document-validity or case-specific border circumstances.

conflicts.explanation: Madagascar's nationality-wide official rule covers every non-Malagasy nationality and makes the non-immigrant short-stay visa available at international airports and ports; it does not establish a Palestinian ordinary-passport exception.
